expected_level_description: You can: - run the governance cycle for boards and committees - review policies and advise on compliance
You can: - run the risk process for a directorate or programme - assess risks against the risk appetite and escalate them - report on risks to committees

You can: - take formal minutes of board and committee meetings, including complex or contentious discussion - keep formal meeting records that stand up to audit and inquiry - advise chairs on what the record should show
You can: - draft and review policies with subject experts - check policies against law, standards, and equality duties - monitor compliance and report gaps
You can: - coordinate evidence for audits and inspections - track audit recommendations and chase overdue actions
You can: - recognise and challenge behaviour that excludes others - consider different needs when you plan your work

You can: - work collaboratively in a group and build relationships with others - identify issues through Agile 'health checks' and work with others to address them - manage stakeholder expectations - be flexible and capable of proactive and reactive communication - host or moderate difficult discussions within the team or with senior stakeholders
